contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires typecheck, lint and tests to pass, DCO sign-off, and tests with each change; per-change checks are in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/contributing/03-open-a-pr.md
documentation_interface_justification: CLI commands, flags and output: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/cheat-sheet.md . service.json input format: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/configuration.md and the published JSON schema. MCP interface: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/mcp.md
repo_interim_justification: All work lands on main through public pull requests between releases: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/pulls?q=is%3Apr
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version on npm (@tdk-landscape/tdk-cli-core) and in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
version_tags_justification: Releases are tagged in git, e.g. v1.3.130 and v1.3.133: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/tags
release_notes_vulns_justification: Release notes name fixed advisories, e.g. 1.3.130 lists GHSA-6w46-j5rx-g56g: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_responses_justification: All 348 issues opened in the last 12 months have a response: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: All 144 enhancement requests in the last 12 months have a response: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/issues?q=label%3Aenhancement
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub security advisories, as described in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/SECURITY.md : https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgement within 3 business days: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_floss_tools_justification: Builds with FLOSS tools only: Bun, Node.js, TypeScript, esbuild, make.
test_justification: Vitest suite (`bun run test`), documented in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and run by the Test job in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_invocation_justification: `bun run test` / `npm test` (vitest run), the standard invocation for a Node/TypeScript package; `make test` also works.
test_most_justification: Coverage can be produced with `make test-coverage` but is not yet measured or enforced in CI.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Tests run on every pull request and push to main: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
tests_are_added_justification: The 10 most recent feature commits all add tests, e.g. #703, #711, #681: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/pull/703/files
warnings_justification: Biome lint (recommended rules) and TypeScript strict mode run in CI: https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: CI lint and typecheck jobs must pass before merge; same-repo PRs get automatic Biome fixes.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript `strict: true` (https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/cli/tsconfig.json) and Biome recommended preset with errors failing CI (https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/cli/biome.json).
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainers apply secure-design principles: secrets are generated with a CSPRNG and redacted from logs (#703), CI actions are SHA-pinned with least-privilege tokens, releases are signed. See https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/security.md
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainers address common errors for a CLI that runs commands and writes files: command/path injection, secret leakage, supply chain. Mitigations: CodeQL, Semgrep, Trivy, OSV-Scanner in CI, fuzzing of service.json parsing, atomic writes. See https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/security.md
crypto_published_justification: Only SHA-256 (verifying upgrade downloads) and the OS CSPRNG via Node's built-in crypto module, both published standards.
crypto_call_justification: All cryptography goes through Node.js `node:crypto` (OpenSSL); TDK implements none itself.
crypto_keylength_justification: Generated secrets are 128-bit (DB passwords) and 256-bit (JWT secrets); hashing uses SHA-256.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithms (MD4, MD5, DES, RC4) are used.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1 or weak modes; SHA-256 only.
crypto_pfs_justification: TDK implements no key-agreement protocol; network TLS is handled by Node.js/OpenSSL.
crypto_password_storage_justification: TDK does not store passwords for authenticating external users.
crypto_random_justification: Keys and secrets are generated with crypto.randomBytes (CSPRNG), e.g. cli/src/utils/env-validator.ts.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release checksums are signed with Sigstore (checksums.txt.sigstore.json) and fetched over HTTPS; verification steps in https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/docs/security.md#releases
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No open Dependabot alerts; no unpatched publicly known medium+ vulnerabilities.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Critical issues are handled first per https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/SECURITY.md ; dependency advisories are fixed in the next release (see CHANGELOG 1.3.129, 1.3.130).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled; no valid credentials are committed.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml) plus Semgrep, Trivy and OSV-Scanner (https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml) run before every release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security queries and Semgrep rules target common JavaScript/TypeScript vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed medium+ findings are fixed before release; results are reviewed in GitHub code scanning.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every pull request and push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based fuzz tests (https://github.com/flisk-sh/tdk-cli-core/blob/main/tests/fuzz/README.md) run on every pull request.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TDK is written in TypeScript, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Fuzz and unit tests run with assertions enabled (vitest expect).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Fuzz failures fail CI and are fixed before merge.
